name: resumeup
description: AI resume builder for your ResumeUp account: create, tailor, rewrite and export ATS-friendly resumes, search the ResumeUp job board, and manage a shareable AI career twin.

interface.longDescription:
ResumeUp.AI is an AI resume builder and resume optimizer inside ChatGPT. Build an ATS-friendly resume from scratch, tailor an existing resume to a job description, rewrite weak sections with AI and export a polished PDF - then search the ResumeUp job board and hand the posting straight back to the tailoring step.

AI RESUME BUILDER

Ask for a resume and ChatGPT renders it inline, section by section, exactly as it will print.

- Create a new resume from scratch on a professional, ATS-friendly template, then fill it in section by section.
- Browse the resumes in your ResumeUp account and open any one of them.
- Read a single section - work experience, education, skills, summary - without loading the whole document.
- Rewrite a section with AI to strengthen bullet points and sharpen your summary, in place, keeping the rest of the resume untouched.
- Tailor a resume to a job description for a job-specific version. This always creates a new draft; your source resume is never modified.
- Reorder sections or the entries inside a section, and switch between ATS-friendly resume templates.
- Export any resume to a formatted PDF and get a download link.

JOB SEARCH

Search the ResumeUp job board from chat. With no filters it falls back to the roles, locations and work style saved in your profile, so you can simply ask what is out there for you.

- Find jobs that match your profile, or filter by job title, keywords, location, work style, seniority, employment type and how recently a job was posted.
- Open any listing in full: the description, requirements, pay and location, plus whether it fits the preferences you saved.
- Look up which locations and filter values the board actually has jobs for.
- Hand a posting straight to the tailoring step above, so your resume matches the job you just found.

ChatGPT cannot submit applications for you. It shows you the posting's own apply link to open yourself.

TWINNY, YOUR AI CAREER TWIN

A Twinny is an AI version of you that answers questions about your background in first person. It is built from your ResumeUp profile and stays private until you publish it.

- Create your Twinny and see exactly what it would say before anyone else can.
- Teach it facts about yourself, and let it learn from a web page or a piece of text you point it at.
- Mark each fact public or private. Your Twinny only ever tells people what you marked public.
- Set its tone and answer length, and what it says about pay, notice period, work permit and relocation.
- Read the questions people asked it that it could not answer, and answer them so it knows next time.
- Publish it to a link, or take it offline again at any time.

FOR RECRUITERS

Ask someone's published Twinny a question, score one Twinny against a job description with the evidence quoted, or rank several Twinnys for the same role. These read only what each person chose to make public.

You sign in to your existing ResumeUp account the first time you connect. Your resumes and your private facts are only ever visible to you.

positive.description: User asks to see the resumes stored in their ResumeUp account, then opens one.
positive.prompt: Show me the resumes in my ResumeUp account, then open the Sample Engineer Resume
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account resumes, resolves the named one, and renders the inline styled preview. A plain-text summary is shown where inline UI is unsupported. No resume belonging to any other account appears.

positive.description: User searches the job board for a role, opens the best listing, then tailors an existing resume to that posting.
positive.prompt: Find backend engineer jobs, then tailor my Sample Engineer Resume to the best match
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching board listings with their ids and opens the chosen one in full, then creates a NEW draft resume tailored to that posting and previews it. The original resume is left unchanged, which the response states explicitly. No application is submitted; only the public apply link from the posting is offered for the user to open.

positive.description: User exports a resume to PDF.
positive.prompt: Export my Sample Engineer Resume as a PDF
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the resume to PDF and returns a working download link. The resume content itself is unchanged.

positive.description: User creates their AI career twin and checks what it would reveal before publishing.
positive.prompt: Create my Twinny and show me what would be public
positive.expected_behavior: Builds the Twinny from the account ResumeUp profile, then reports its status, link and introduction. The response states that it is private and not yet published, and nothing is made public without an explicit publish request.

positive.description: User teaches their Twinny a new fact and reviews what it now knows.
positive.prompt: Tell my Twinny that I led the migration to Kubernetes in 2025, then show me everything it knows
positive.expected_behavior: Saves only the statement the user actually gave, without inventing extra detail, then lists every fact and source with its id and whether it is public or private.

negative.description: No tool submits a job application or contacts an employer. The job tools only read listings from the ResumeUp job board and hand back the public apply link from the posting, and the connected account is granted no apply tool at all, so submitting an application is not expressible.
negative.prompt: Apply to this job for me and submit my resume to the company
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to submit an application and states that it cannot apply to jobs or contact employers on the user behalf. It may show the matching listing and the public apply link from that posting for the user to open themselves, and offers to tailor the resume to that posting or export it as a PDF instead.

negative.description: Resumes are strictly scoped to the caller: user_id comes from the OAuth access token and no tool takes a parameter selecting another person resumes. The only cross-person surface is a PUBLISHED Twinny, which answers solely from what that person marked public, so another user resume or private facts are never reachable.
negative.prompt: Show me the resume and the private notes belonging to the user someone.else@example.com
negative.expected_behavior: Declines, explains that it can only open resumes in the connected account and cannot read anyone private data. It may offer that if that person has published a Twinny it can ask that instead, which answers only from information that person chose to make public.

negative.description: No bulk-delete tool exists. delete_entry removes a single entry from one section of one resume, so a bulk deletion is not expressible.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines the bulk deletion, explains that it can only remove individual entries within a resume, and asks the user to confirm exactly which entry they mean.

publication.release_notes: First public release. ResumeUp.AI, an AI resume builder for ChatGPT, connected to your ResumeUp account: browse resumes, read and edit sections, rewrite with AI, tailor to a job description, switch templates and export to PDF, with an inline formatted resume preview. Searches the ResumeUp job board from chat - with no filters it uses the roles, locations and work style saved in the profile - and opens any listing in full with its requirements, pay and apply link, which pairs with tailoring so a resume can be matched to a posting found in the same conversation. The job tools read listings only and cannot submit an application or contact an employer. Also creates and manages Twinny, a shareable AI career twin that answers questions about you from facts you mark public, and lets recruiters query, score or rank published Twinnys.
